definitions.explanation: Describes pleasantly warm weather or temperature. Written 暖かい for weather/climate.
Describes a warm, kind personality or warm feelings. Can also be written 温かい for this meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暖|あたた}かい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暖|あたた}かく⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{暖|あたた}かい⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}みたい→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I want to rest in a warm room.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一年|いちねん}{中|じゅう}{暖|あたた}かい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This country is warm all year round.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧{暖|あたた}かい⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぜんぜん→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦{降|ふ}りません→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: Even though it's winter, the warm days continue and it doesn't snow at all.

examples.japanese: {暖|あたた}かい⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{暖|あたた}かい⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ありがとう→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for your kind words.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暖|あたた}かい⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うれしかった→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I was happy about everyone's warm feelings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{暖|あたた}かい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧で、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}けて→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He is a warm person and is always helping others.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{暖|あたた}かくて、⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{助|たす}けて→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦もらいました→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: The people in this town are very warm, and they helped me a lot when I moved here.

notes: {暖|あたた}かい (with {暖|だん}, meaning 'warmth') is used for weather and climate. {温|あたた}かい (with {温|おん}, meaning 'temperature') is used for warm objects, food, or figuratively for warm personalities. Both are read あたたかい. Also commonly shortened to あったかい in casual speech.
